notes.title: PLAYTEST version 1.07 is live now!
notes.notes:
Hello Commanders!

Playtests are still ongoing, and we’re not slowing down. That’s why we’re rushing to fix the most common issues reported. In this update, you’ll find:

a fix for tanks getting stuck in the tutorial,

a fix for the 2D map,

a fix for capturing the objective in Aachen,

improved HMG accuracy.


We’ve tested these internally, but we’d greatly appreciate your feedback. Feel free to reach out to us on Discord or Steam, and if you encounter any new bugs, keep sending in Bug Reports – they’re very important to us.

In addition, we’ve added:

projectile ballistics (yes, that's right!),

kill cam when destroying an enemy tank,

small improvements to some sound effects.

Thank you for being with us and helping us grow the game!

Discord: https://discord.gg/2jgxDJ5cst

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ironwolfstudio

Steam (developer's page): https://store.steampowered.com/developer/IronWolfStudio

All best!
Iron Wolf Studio Team
